The Core Problem & Industry Breakthrough

In modern digital marketing, a single promotional campaign spans Instagram captions, display banners, PDF specifications, and email newsletters. Today, reviews are handled manually via fragmented email and Slack threads. Mismatched discounts (e.g. 30% on graphic vs. 20% in copy), prohibited health claims ("Miracle chill"), and missing legal qualifiers routinely trigger regulatory penalties, expensive corrective reprints, and severe brand equity damage.

CampaignGuard solves this deterministically. Brand Managers establish a canonical Truth Contract. When Creators upload assets, our 4-layer multimodal engine automatically identifies contradictions, highlights exact graphic bounding boxes via spatial OCR, groups actionable remediation tickets, and allows Reviewers to bind sign-offs with an immutable cryptographic SHA-256 seal.

Zero-Friction Evaluation Guarantee & Dual Persistence

To guarantee zero judge lockouts and zero cold-start delay, CampaignGuard uses a dual-tier architecture: an in-memory benchmark store pre-seeded with 4 benchmark campaigns and live change orders for instant evaluation, coupled with a complete, typed Prisma ORM SQLite/PostgreSQL schema (prisma/schema.prisma) for durable enterprise deployments. Judges can test role boundaries via the instant switcher or test real invite link lifecycles via /invite?token=inv_ecosip_creator_demo.

Multi-Role Access Control & Campaign Invitation Links

Enterprise marketing governance requires strict separation of duties: Creators must not approve their own work, and Reviewers must not alter brand truth rules. In Round 3, we implemented authentic tokenized invitation links and scoped role workspaces.

Tokenized Invite Link Architecture

Brand Managers generate cryptographically random, role-restricted invitation tokens with 7-day expiration dates.

  • Route: /invite?token=[token]
  • State Verification: Real-time token validation against campaign membership, 7-day expiration (410 on expiry), and REVOKED flags.
  • 1-Click Acceptance: Invited creators or legal reviewers enter their name and automatically join the workspace.
  • Server-Side 403 RBAC: /api/packs/approve rejects non-Reviewer approval calls with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
  • Revocation Control: Brand Leads can inspect active links, copy URLs, and instantly revoke pending tokens.

Visual OCR & Evidence-Linked Creative Change Orders

In traditional workflows, when an AI flag is raised (e.g. "discount discrepancy"), creators don't know where on the banner graphic the mistake occurs. Round 3 solves this by pairing Google Gemini 1.5 Flash multimodal spatial vision with interactive SVG bounding boxes and grouped Change Order tickets.

Spatial Bounding Box Extraction

Our prompt instructs Gemini 1.5 Flash to return normalized 2D bounding boxes (box_2d: [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] scaled 0–1000). The frontend converts these into responsive SVG coordinate overlays:

  • Precision Targeting: Identifies headline discount badges, subheaders, and missing footnote locations.
  • Bidirectional Highlighting: Clicking a bounding box on the graphic scrolls and highlights the matching finding card.

Change Orders & Revision Diffing

Instead of loose alert noise, visual findings are bundled into formal Change Orders (e.g. #co_ecosip_01):

  • Structured Tickets: Location, violation evidence, contract rule, and suggested correction.
  • Revision v2 Upload: Creators submit revised copy and graphics. The engine re-analyzes assets and marks corrected items as RESOLVED.

Technical Architecture
Multimodal Engine & Cryptographic Integrity

System Architecture & Cryptographic Version-Lock

CampaignGuard is engineered as a high-reliability, zero-latency system designed to operate deterministically under adversarial conditions and withstand accidental or malicious out-of-band modifications.

The 4-Layer Inspection Pipeline

Layer Target Checks Engine
1. Facts Discount %, expiry dates, pricing claims Deterministic regex + Gemini
2. Cross-Asset Copy vs Banner vs Spec Sheet conflicts Gemini 1.5 Flash Vision
3. Brand Rules Forbidden superlatives, mandatory qualifiers Rule-matching parser
4. A11y Contrast ratio, alt-text presence Heuristic + Vision

SHA-256 Lock & Invalidation Protocol

When an Authorised Reviewer signs off, CampaignGuard computes an immutable SHA-256 seal:

SHA256(caption + bannerBase64 + pdfText + contractVersion)

Adversarial Invalidation: If a creator attempts an unauthorized copy tweak or an agency modifies a banner after approval, the cryptographic checksum fails instantly, flipping campaign status to INVALIDATED.

High-Reliability Unified Edge Store

On ephemeral serverless runtimes like Vercel, traditional SQLite databases write to ephemeral temporary disk, causing state resets between concurrent edge lambda invocations. CampaignGuard implements a dual-layer persistence model:

  • Local Execution: Full Prisma ORM with SQLite database migrations (prisma/dev.db).
  • Production Serverless: In-memory global singleton store pre-seeded with rich benchmark campaigns, active members, invites, and change orders. Eliminates cold-start delays and database setup friction, ensuring deterministic evaluation reliability.

Adversarial Security & Prompt Injection Defense

All user-uploaded copy and banner texts are treated strictly as UNTRUSTED DATA payloads. Prompts encapsulate inputs within isolated demarcation blocks and enforce system-instruction precedence to reject embedded prompt injection attempts.

Comprehensive Testing Suite & Reliability Proof

Per Round 3 requirements ("Make it hold up without you. Bad input, an empty state, a refresh, the same action twice — nothing should break or hang"), CampaignGuard underwent rigorous automated testing across compilation, API endpoints, and edge cases.

Adversarial Input Handling

- Missing Fields: API routes validate required fields and return structured HTTP 400 responses without uncaught exceptions.
- Malformed Tokens: /invite?token=invalid_xyz gracefully renders an informative error card with a direct return link to the home page.
- Rapid Re-clicks: 1-Click fix actions disable buttons with loading spinners to prevent race conditions.
